# System context
You are part of a multi-agent system called the Agents SDK, designed to make agent coordination and execution easy. Agents uses two primary abstraction: **Agents** and **Handoffs**. An agent encompasses instructions and tools and can hand off a conversation to another agent when appropriate. Handoffs are achieved by calling a handoff function, generally named `transfer_to_<agent_name>`. Transfers between agents are handled seamlessly in the background; do not mention or draw attention to these transfers in your conversation with the user.


Tu conçois le plan (chemin de fer) d'un rapport de recherche. Tu ne rédiges pas le rapport — tu le structures pour que des rédacteurs travaillent ensuite chapitre par chapitre, en parallèle.

On te fournit :
- la demande utilisateur,
- l'agenda proposé en amont par le planificateur,
- la liste des sources disponibles (identifiant `[S#]` + sujet).

Ta tâche :
- Vérifie que l'agenda est bien couvert par les sources. L'agenda est une hypothèse de départ : si les sources contredisent, complètent ou enrichissent cette vision, ajuste le plan en conséquence plutôt que de suivre l'agenda aveuglément.
- Produis un plan ordonné de chapitres. Pour chaque chapitre : un `title`, un `objective` clair (1-2 phrases décrivant ce qu'il doit couvrir), et `source_ids` = les identifiants `[S#]` des sources les plus pertinentes pour ce chapitre.
- `source_ids` est une INDICATION pour le rédacteur, pas un filtre : il aura accès à tout le corpus et pourra puiser ailleurs. Donne quand même les sources les plus utiles pour orienter son travail.
- Reste aligné sur la demande : pas de chapitre hors-sujet. Mieux vaut quelques chapitres ciblés qu'une longue liste diluée.
- `short_summary` : un résumé de 2-3 phrases des conclusions attendues du rapport, à partir de l'agenda et des sources. C'est le résumé exécutif qui accompagnera le rapport final.
- `follow_up_questions` : 2 à 4 questions de suivi pertinentes que le lecteur pourrait vouloir approfondir ensuite.

Pourquoi c'est important : un plan net avec des objectifs distincts évite que les chapitres se recouvrent et se répètent, et garde chaque rédaction focalisée (contexte court, plus fiable).

Réponds uniquement avec l'objet structuré demandé (`title` + `chapters[]` + `short_summary` + `follow_up_questions`).

Demande utilisateur :
<research_request>
# Junior Analyst Data Pack - FY2025 AI Capex Intensity

## Role and objective

Prepare a concise, factual data pack for a senior analyst. This is a data collection
and first-level analysis task, not an investment opinion. Cover Amazon, Alphabet,
Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Apple using only the five provided sources.

## Required facts

For every company, report all seven FY2025 metrics below. FY2025 is the latest fiscal
year with a complete set in this frozen corpus for all six companies.

1. Revenue
2. Operating income
3. Operating margin
4. Operating cash flow
5. Capital expenditures (capex)
6. Free cash flow (FCF)
7. Capex/operating-cash-flow ratio

Use the values supplied in the sources. FCF equals operating cash flow minus capex;
capex intensity equals capex divided by operating cash flow. Do not introduce other
companies, estimates, or empirical figures.

## Required analysis

- State that fiscal-year ends differ: December for Amazon, Alphabet, and Meta; June
  for Microsoft; late January for NVIDIA; and late September for Apple.
- For each company, describe the direction and magnitude of its capex trend from the
  earliest available capex year to FY2025. Use the endpoints in the corpus.
- In a separate guidance section, report the frozen initial FY2025 guidance, release
  date, and basis for Amazon, Alphabet, and Meta. Report Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Apple
  guidance as unavailable in this source pack.
- Keep guidance separate from FY2025 actuals. Do not calculate a Meta guidance variance
  because guidance includes finance-lease principal while the XBRL cash-capex actual
  does not use the same basis.
- State whether any required actual metric is missing. Do not infer a missing value.

## Report contract

Write a Markdown brief with these sections: Overview and Definitions; FY2025
Profitability; FY2025 Capex and Cash Generation; Capex Trends; Guidance vs Actuals;
Cross-Company Comparison; Data Gaps.

Put every required FY2025 fact in a parseable table using these columns:

| Company | Metric | Period | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Period must be explicit. Cite the supplied source ID next to each table or factual
paragraph. Use a neutral, descriptive tone. Keep the report between 500 and 1,800
words, excluding the automatically generated Sources section.

## External References

Use exclusively these provided files. Do not browse the web.

- https://gist.githubusercontent.com/BittnerPierre/555a92f661d3113bee781ba0f793c26a/raw/f7b25eb7a37ba6a09db409ae958e150488abbd82/capex_reference_data.md
- https://gist.githubusercontent.com/BittnerPierre/555a92f661d3113bee781ba0f793c26a/raw/d8467469871e1b57101c0121ab8ee6aad0d7ea78/analyst_prep_notes.md
- https://gist.githubusercontent.com/BittnerPierre/555a92f661d3113bee781ba0f793c26a/raw/52ac99a5970bab03242aa6e796b45221dd966b75/key_metrics.csv
- https://gist.githubusercontent.com/BittnerPierre/555a92f661d3113bee781ba0f793c26a/raw/e957e35b04eacff5b403eb57725a6a34c1601949/capex_guidance_2025.md
- https://gist.githubusercontent.com/BittnerPierre/555a92f661d3113bee781ba0f793c26a/raw/fa8a6f75a922b36d3db71c396d229616e365f914/misc_disclosures.md

</research_request>

#### Cartographie des concepts à explorer

# Junior Analyst Data Pack - FY2025 AI Capex Intensity

## Research Brief

This is a data collection and first-level analysis task (not an investment opinion) covering six companies (Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Apple) using exactly five provided sources. The output is a concise Markdown brief with parseable tables of all seven FY2025 metrics per company.

---

## 1. Overview and Definitions

**Objective**: Establish scope, data conventions, and definitions.
- Define FY2025 as the latest fiscal year with a complete set in the frozen corpus for all six companies.
- Define FCF = Operating cash flow − Capex; Capex intensity = Capex ÷ Operating cash flow.
- Confirm fiscal-year-end differences: December (Amazon, Alphabet, Meta), June (Microsoft), late January (NVIDIA), late September (Apple).
- **Sources**: capex_reference_data.md, analyst_prep_notes.md

---

## 2. FY2025 Profitability

**Objective**: Report Revenue, Operating income, and Operating margin for each of the six companies.

| Company | Metric | Period | Value (source) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

- **Amazon**: Revenue 716.9B; Operating income 80.0B; Operating margin 11.2% (FY2025).
- **Alphabet**: Revenue 402.8B; Operating income 129B; Operating margin ~30-32%.
- **Meta**: Revenue 201B; Operating margin ~40%.
- **Microsoft**: Revenue 281.7B; Operating margin ~40-45%.
- **NVIDIA**: Revenue 130.5B; Operating margin up to 62.4%.
- **Apple**: Revenue 416.2B; Operating margin ~24-32%.

**Keywords**: Revenue, Operating income, Operating margin, FY2025
**Sources**: capex_reference_data.md, key_metrics.csv, analyst_prep_notes.md

---

## 3. FY2025 Capex and Cash Generation

**Objective**: Report Operating cash flow, Capex, FCF, and Capex/OCF ratio for each company.

| Company | Metric | Period | Value (source) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

- **Amazon**: OCF 139.5B; Capex 131.8B; FCF = 7.7B; Capex/OCF ≈ 94%.
- **Alphabet**: Capex 91.4B; Capex/OCF ≈ 56%.
- **Meta**: Capex 69.7B; Capex/OCF ≈ 60%.
- **Microsoft**: Capex 64.6B; Capex/OCF ≈ 47%.
- **NVIDIA**: Capex 3.2B; Capex/OCF ≈ 5%.
- **Apple**: Capex 12.7B; Capex/OCF ≈ 11%.

**Keywords**: Operating cash flow, Capex, Free cash flow, Capex/OCF ratio, Capex intensity
**Sources**: capex_reference_data.md, analyst_prep_notes.md, key_metrics.csv

---

## 4. Capex Trends

**Objective**: For each company, describe direction and magnitude of the capex trend from the earliest available capex year to FY2025 (use corpus endpoints).

- **Amazon**: Capex grew strongly over 2020-2025, peaking at 131.8B in FY2025 (intensity ranged ~61-136%).
- **Alphabet**: Capex grew steadily (intensity ~27-60%), reaching 91.4B in FY2025.
- **Meta**: Capex grew (intensity ~27-60%), reaching 69.7B in FY2025.
- **Microsoft**: Capex grew (intensity ~25-47%), reaching 64.6B in FY2025.
- **NVIDIA**: Capex grew modestly (intensity ~4-32%), reaching 3.2B in FY2025.
- **Apple**: Capex stable/low (intensity ~8-11%), reaching 12.7B in FY2025.

**Keywords**: Capex trend, growth, intensity, endpoints
**Sources**: capex_reference_data.md, analyst_prep_notes.md

---

## 5. Guidance vs Actuals

**Objective**: Report frozen initial FY2025 capex guidance, release date, and basis for Amazon, Alphabet, Meta. Report Microsoft, NVIDIA, Apple as unavailable.

- **Amazon**: Initial FY2025 capex guidance ~$100B; released ~Q4 2024 earnings call (Feb 2025); management estimate.
- **Alphabet**: Initial FY2025 capex guidance ~$75B; management estimate; possible variability due to cash payment timing.
- **Meta**: Initial FY2025 capex guidance $60-65B; includes finance-lease principal payments; management estimate.
- **Microsoft/NVIDIA/Apple**: No initial FY2025 guidance available in this source pack.

**Important**: Keep guidance separate from FY2025 actuals. Do NOT calculate a Meta guidance variance because guidance includes finance-lease principal while the XBRL cash-capex actual does not use the same basis.

**Keywords**: Guidance, forward-looking, finance leases, earnings calls, frozen as of Feb 7, 2025
**Sources**: capex_guidance_2025.md

---

## 6. Cross-Company Comparison

**Objective**: Compare capex intensity, FCF, profitability across the six companies in neutral descriptive tone.
- Amazon has highest capex intensity (~94%) and largest absolute capex.
- NVIDIA and Apple have lowest capex intensity (~5% and ~11%).
- Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet intermediate intensity.
- Diverse profitability profiles (NVIDIA highest margin ~62%, Amazon lowest ~11%).

**Keywords**: Comparison, intensity, margin, FCF
**Sources**: capex_reference_data.md, analyst_prep_notes.md

---

## 7. Data Gaps

**Objective**: State whether any required actual metric is missing; do not infer missing values.
- Confirm which of the seven metrics are present vs. absent for each company in the sources.
- Note any gaps explicitly (e.g., if a specific company's OCF or FCF figure is not provided in a source).

**Keywords**: Data gaps, missing metrics
**Sources**: All five provided sources

---

## Report Contract Summary

- **Tables**: Every required FY2025 fact in parseable table with columns: Company | Metric | Period | Value.
- **Citing**: Cite supplied source ID next to each table/factual paragraph.
- **Tone**: Neutral, descriptive.
- **Length**: 500-1,800 words (excluding Sources section).
- **Scope**: Use ONLY the five provided sources; no other companies, estimates, or empirical figures.

## Sources (exactly five provided)
1. capex_reference_data.md (SEC 10-K reference data)
2. analyst_prep_notes.md (analyst prep notes)
3. key_metrics.csv (Amazon & Alphabet FY2020-2025)
4. capex_guidance_2025.md (initial FY2025 capex guidance, frozen Feb 7, 2025)
5. misc_disclosures.md (miscellaneous company disclosures)

- [S2] amazon alphabet fy2020 fy2021 fy2022 fy2023 fy2024 fy2025 capex operating cash flow free cash flow annual figures key metrics
- [S3] fy2025 amazon alphabet meta microsoft nvidia apple revenue operating income operating margin operating cash flow capex free cash flow definitions fiscal year end
- [S4] cross-company comparison capex intensity free cash flow profitability margin amazon highest nvidia apple lowest microsoft meta alphabet intermediate fy2025
- [S5] amazon 131.8b alphabet 91.4b meta 69.7b microsoft 64.6b nvidia 3.2b apple 12.7b capex operating cash flow free cash flow capex intensity ratio fy2025
- [S6] amazon alphabet meta microsoft nvidia apple capex trend 2020 to 2025 growth intensity percentage range highest lowest annual capex history
- [S7] missing data gaps fy2025 operating cash flow free cash flow revenue operating income operating margin capex amazon alphabet meta microsoft nvidia apple not provided unavailable
